name: Creature to Koi Shiyo!! for Otome
original_name: クリーチャーと恋しよっ！ for乙女
source:
An original mystery horror love story! An otome game where players will capture the hearts of a wide range of creatures! Ordinary youth. Ordinary love. Which boy will you choose?

[From [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/creature-romances/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
一部原创神秘恐怖恋爱故事！一款让玩家俘获各种生物芳心的乙女游戏！普通的青春，普通的爱情。你会选择哪位男孩？

[来源：[url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/creature-romances/]官方网站[/url]]
